fields.label: Salary Component
fields.description: Pick the deduction by the name it has on the payslip. Its account is filled in beside it. Leave blank and set the account directly for anything with no component behind it.

fields.label: Liability Account
fields.description: Filled in from the component. Several components can share one account - all four NSSF tiers usually do - and the journal credits it once, so this is what the payment actually clears.

fields.label: Paid From
fields.description: The bank this particular liability is paid out of - KCB, Absa, whichever the company settles it from.

fields.label: Never Remit
fields.description: No draft is raised for this account at all. For something owed but not settled in cash - a provision, or a balance carried forward.
